title: Breaking Down Programming Paradigms: APL's Surprising Learning Curve // Aaron Hsu // Dyalog '17
summary: Aaron Hsu explains why programmers often find APL harder to learn than people with no programming background. He identifies eight patterns that contrast traditional software engineering practice with APL practice, starting from Ken Iverson's language design principles.
why: Shared in APL threads as a thought-provoking talk with lots of useful commentary beyond the slides.

quote.text: Lots of good commentary not in the slides.
